description: The Coinbase exchange adapter of the Eclipse Markets suite (Wing A), in M0 public-data form. Coinbase ships official MCPs (account trading, wallet, CDP); Strike re-implements none of them — it is the thin public-data adapter over Coinbase-shaped product and level-2 book fixtures, normalized through the Eclipse Book core (the same canonical builders Forecast uses, so cross-adapter parity is testable). Native product statuses the core vocabulary does not map surface as UNMAPPED with the native string preserved. Quotes carry all-in cost from the venue's dated fee schedule; a stale schedule degrades to FEE_UNVERIFIED. No account tools exist in this build: account paths are an M1+ governed wrap of the vendor's account MCP, behind vault credentials and the core placement gate.
